title: Beastmaster: new beasts
description: New beasts for the Beastmaster mod, made with Meshy: the Aurochs (a huge horned wild bull on the game boar's skeleton, it charges) and the Panther (a sleek black big cat on the game sabretooth's skeleton, quick). Wild ones appear now and then when Beastmaster is installed; tame one and call it.
notes: The sources are not in the repository: the Meshy glbs and textures, the fitted glbs, the game dumps; the paths below point to a local folder. Build: python -I tools/models/make_mod.py tools/models/packs/beastmaster_beasts.json
The GUIDs are fixed forever: mods/beastmaster/species.lua and players' saves refer to them. The bear has its own pack (beastmaster_bear.json).

Aurochs: Meshy preview 01a17d29-eb7e-76df-bfb0-61b5589e5b22, refine 01a17d34-3937-73cc-8d5f-8c6710102ae2; fitted with blender/fit_to_game_skeleton.py --keep-uvs --keep-head onto enemy_wildboar_01 (skeleton d3cb046d, body material 1); a copy of Enemy_Wildbeast_Boar with ScaleComponent 1.3, DamageMod multiplier x1.4, Movement speeds x0.9 (health x3 comes from Beastmaster at runtime).

Panther: Meshy preview 01a17d5e-7073-76ab-a388-51aaa3d61162, refine 01a17d60-0bd0-71c7-8431-6f3a25d6a014; fitted with blender/fit_to_game_skeleton.py --keep-uvs --keep-head --material 1 onto char_enemy_sabretooth_01 (skeleton ef2d7e9f, body material 1; its rest pose holds the front paws 0.35 m low, the fitter stretches the front legs to them); a copy of Enemy_Wildbeast_Sabertooth with ScaleComponent 0.85, DamageMod multiplier x1.2, Movement speeds x1.15.
